selection: Build only from the original 918 capture: collect all complete nonzero scalar classes of size four. The held-out capture supplies an independent prediction, without influencing the plan.
mechanism: A bounded per-key auxiliary cache prepares only sums of listed four-point index sets, with admission before allocation. Every current exact class must equal all four stored indices to use the sum. All other classes and unknown keys use exact ordinary group reduction.
qualify: Frozen vs ordinary must calibrate within 2% on both inputs. The prepared route needs lower paired medians and at least six of eight wins against both controls on both inputs.
route: Separate runs check cache construction, exact hit counts on every prime and proof, wrong source dimensions, and fallback with zero optional workspace.
proof: All process exports independently checked with Gnark against the pinned source image and request digest.
